job.job_description:
About Leena AI
Leena AI is a leader in Agentic AI for the enterprise. We are building an iconic company, delivering AI Colleagues that transform back-office functions and accelerate the full promise of Generative AI - unlocking real productivity gains, cutting costs, and delighting employees at scale.
Leena AI provides the most forward-looking, open, and scalable Agentic AI architecture for the enterprise - it empowers CIOs and CTOs to develop, deploy, and manage AI Colleagues for the back office at scale. Built with full governance, compliance, security, and auditability at its core.
Leena AI integrates with 1000+ applications, including SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, and Microsoft Office 365. We are proud to be trusted by 500+ global enterprises and 20 million+ employees, including leading brands such as Nestl , Puma, Coca-Cola, Sony, and Etihad Airways.
Founded in 2018 and headquartered in New York, Leena AI has secured over $40M in financing from top-tier investors including Greycroft, Bessemer Venture Partners, B Capital, and Y Combinator.

What Youll Do
Partner with Sales Engineers and Account Executives to understand customer requirements and design AI-powered solutions.
Configure AI agents, workflows, and autonomous AI capabilities within the Leena AI platform.
Build customer-specific Proof of Concepts (POCs) and technical demos.
Integrate enterprise systems such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, ServiceNow, Oracle, Microsoft 365, Slack, and other third-party applications using APIs.
Develop lightweight extensions, prompts, and automation using Python and/or TypeScript .
Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions by connecting AI agents with customer knowledge sources.
Troubleshoot, iterate, and optimize solutions based on customer feedback.
Deliver engaging technical demonstrations and solution walkthroughs to both technical and business audiences.
Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to convert customer learnings into scalable product capabilities.
What Were Looking For
3 5 years of experience in Software Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, or another customer-facing technical role, preferably within B2B SaaS.
Strong programming skills in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript .
Hands-on experience working with LLMs, Agentic AI, Prompt Engineering, RAG, Tool Calling, and AI workflows .
Experience integrating systems using REST APIs and webhooks.
Good understanding of SQL, data modelling, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong ownership mindset with the ability to thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
Willingness to work overlapping hours with our US-based Sales Engineering team.
Nice to Have
Experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, or Solutions/Sales Engineer.
Experience with enterprise platforms such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, ServiceNow, Oracle, Microsoft 365, ADP, or Slack .
Familiarity with LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, A2A , or similar AI frameworks.
Understanding of enterprise security concepts such as SSO, data privacy, and PII handling.
Experience working in customer-facing implementation or professional services environments.
Why Join Leena AI
Build AI solutions that solve real business problems for global enterprises.
Work at the forefront of Agentic AI alongside world-class engineers and product leaders.
Partner directly with customers and influence how enterprise AI is adopted.
Gain exposure to cutting-edge AI technologies, enterprise integrations, and large-scale deployments.
Be part of a fast-growing, high-impact team where youll own meaningful work from day one.
